newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian elephant goes on rampage, kills one.
newsitem.headline: Indian elephant goes on rampage, kills one.

text.p: An elephant hit by a speeding lorry went on the rampage and killed a tractor driver in India's eastern state of West Bengal on Thursday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) news agency reported.

It quoted Prasun Mukherjee, a senior state police official, as saying the incident occured in the Hooghly district, 75 km (45 miles) southwest of the state capital Calcutta after the lorry hit the animal.
The maddened elephant raced into nearby paddy fields and attacked a tractor, overturning it and trampling the driver. It then escaped into the nearby woods.
Forest officials had spread out with tranquiliser guns to track down the animal, the official added.
